1) the use of alternative PV array configurations can be a good strategy for reducing mismatch losses; 2) this strategy is particularly useful in partially shaded conditions; 3) the use of the proposed method can lead to an increase in the annual energy production of PV plants.
we propose a method to forecast PV array power production subject of mismatch losses.

1) a novel method to simulate and forecast PV power production in different environmental conditions is presented, 2) the proposed model simulates PV arrays in order to reduce module mismatch losses, and 3) the model is validated by experimental data taken on a 2200 Wp plant with three different interconnections, which show reliable production forecast precision in partially shaded and normal conditions.
